goals.2: Temperature: zehn Grad, minus fünf Grad
grammar.0.title: Weather words
grammar.0.note: Germany uses Celsius. „minus fünf Grad“ = −5°C. In winter it hovers around zero; in summer it is 20–30 degrees.
grammar.1.title: Directions (Himmelsrichtungen)
grammar.2.title: Understanding a weather report
grammar.2.text: A report usually goes: the region first (im Norden), then the conditions (bewölkt), then the temperature (bis zu 20 Grad). „Es gibt“ + Akkusativ = “there will be / there is”. Useful words: Regenschirm, Jacke, Handschuhe, Mütze.
quiz.4.prompt: What does „Es sind minus fünf Grad“ mean?
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “In the south the sun is shining.”
